title: Tight boots? No. She’s lame! O!
html_source: The ‘O!’ of realisation subtly references the ‘O!’s that soundtracked Bloom’s mastubatory climax, giving the 'O!’ a new context and re-appropriating it for the melancholy realisation that Gerty in fact has a limp.
